duration_evidence: Unvalidated production estimates. These are goals for authored active play, not measured or guaranteed hours; no shipped-hour claim is permitted.
quality_gates: Each content unit has original authored events and an identifiable decision or mastery lesson.
Travel, idle time, repeated clears and mutually exclusive alternatives do not inflate first-playthrough hour budgets.
Every choice has visible immediate feedback and at least one persistent consequence.
All regions and quests have save/reload and migration coverage.
Every class has end-to-end solo accessibility and distinct resource feedback.
Hours remain estimates until independent timed playtests publish route, skill, difficulty and active-play distributions.
No activity, character, item, journal row or map marker is removed to manufacture frame-time improvements.

regions.title: Hearthmere, Hollow Moor and Forgotten Sanctum

acts.premise: Recover the Concord and discover that stolen names, not souls, sustain the old divinity.

endgame_disciplines.title: Shattered Concord Expeditions
endgame_disciplines.premise: Selectable deterministic seed, evolving contracts, recovery exits and earned rewards; existing prototype expands here.
